about: Behavioural evals for the sc-asset-* skills (Anthropic skill-authoring practice: at least 3 scenarios, measured against a no-skill baseline). Run each scenario twice with fresh agents, once in a worktree with the asset skills removed (baseline) and once on main, then grade every output blind: two fresh reviewers see one sheet with the reference row on top and the shuffled, unlabelled renders below (imgdiff first). Record results in docs/superpowers/handoff/. Re-run after any big skill change; a skill edit that loses to its previous version is reverted. Needs the fg-aaa-prop tools ported (M8).
measures: audit hygiene and tris against docs/PHASE1.md 3.3
blind reviewer lines: silhouette, proportion, edges, micro-detail, roughness, colour, story, read
colour and value of the render measured with sc_ref_palette.py --k 7 against PHASE1 3.1

scenarios.query: Build the Cellars oak barrel for batch B7: a coopered wine barrel about 0.9 m tall on a wooden cradle, iron hoops, one head stained by a drip from its tap, warm lamplit cellar.
expected_behavior: coopered staves and hoops standing proud, not a smooth cylinder
about 10% oversized, chunky hoops and chimes
the drip stain as a placed wear beat readable at thumbnail size
barrel oak from the shared B2 tileable or one family bake

scenarios.query: Build one half-timber facade wall panel with a window for batch B4: oak posts and a brace on lime plaster, about 1.2 m wide and 3 m tall, slightly out of true.
expected_behavior: timber sections about 1.4x real, 1-3 deg off true
chamfers of at least 1.5 cm on edges seen at play distance
plaster and oak from the shared B1 tileables and trim sheet, no unique bake
joins its neighbours on the kit grid

scenarios.query: Build the B11 hero cellar lantern: a wrought-iron lantern with horn or glass panes and a candle, hung from a bracket, the light source of the dungeon corner.
expected_behavior: dense damaged high baked to a clean low with a unique set
glass as fake refraction, emission kept at or below 1 in the bake
iron reads black and worn with something to reflect
blind A/B against the reference row with imgdiff run first
